# Neural Word Embeddings

> Skip-gram word embeddings with negative sampling, built from scratch: hand-derived gradients, a unigram negative-sampling table, and cosine similarity, nearest-neighbor, and analogy queries.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/neural-word-embeddings

## Source

- [src/neural_word_embeddings/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/neural-word-embeddings/blob/main/src/neural_word_embeddings/__init__.py): Neural Word Embeddings - skip-gram with negative sampling from scratch.
- [src/neural_word_embeddings/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/neural-word-embeddings/blob/main/src/neural_word_embeddings/cli.py): Command line interface for the word-embedding model.
- [src/neural_word_embeddings/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/neural-word-embeddings/blob/main/src/neural_word_embeddings/data.py): A bundled, semantically structured corpus for demonstration and evaluation.
- [src/neural_word_embeddings/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/neural-word-embeddings/blob/main/src/neural_word_embeddings/evaluation.py): Evaluate embeddings by category-retrieval accuracy.
- [src/neural_word_embeddings/linalg.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/neural-word-embeddings/blob/main/src/neural_word_embeddings/linalg.py): Minimal from-scratch vector operations for the embedding model.
- [src/neural_word_embeddings/model.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/neural-word-embeddings/blob/main/src/neural_word_embeddings/model.py): Skip-gram word embeddings with negative sampling, trained from scratch.
- [src/neural_word_embeddings/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/neural-word-embeddings/blob/main/src/neural_word_embeddings/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/neural_word_embeddings/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/neural-word-embeddings/blob/main/src/neural_word_embeddings/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the trained word embeddings.
- [src/neural_word_embeddings/vocabulary.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/neural-word-embeddings/blob/main/src/neural_word_embeddings/vocabulary.py): Deterministic tokenization and vocabulary construction.
